section: Defence platforms and systems - Tejas LCA, Arjun MBT, radar and EW systems, naval platforms
subsections: Radar and EW - types, indigenous radars, AEW&C
Coast Guard - vessel classes and roles

accepted.s: Which type of radar measures the speed of an object from the frequency shift of the reflected signal and is used in weather radars?
accepted.x: Doppler radar measures speed through the frequency shift of the returned signal and is used in weather radars.
accepted.tq: Identify the radar from its distinctive operating principle and application.
accepted.sec: Radar and EW - types, indigenous radars, AEW&C  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR):
1. It is used for imaging at night.
2. It can produce images through clouds.
3. It depends exclusively on visible light.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: SAR enables imaging at night and through clouds. It does not depend exclusively on visible light.
accepted.tq: Reject the extreme word ‘exclusively’ and identify the two valid capabilities.
accepted.sec: Radar and EW - types, indigenous radars, AEW&C  [APPSC]

accepted.s: With reference to AESA radar, which one of the following statements is correct?
o: It requires a mechanically rotating antenna for beam steering.
It has a transmit/receive module on every antenna element and electronically steers the beam.
It uses HF waves reflected from the ionosphere.
It is used only for measuring rainfall.
accepted.x: Active Electronically Scanned Array radar has a transmit/receive module on each element and steers its beam electronically without a moving antenna.
accepted.tq: Use the defining hardware feature to distinguish AESA from mechanically scanned radar.
accepted.sec: Radar and EW - types, indigenous radars, AEW&C  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the operating principle of an over-the-horizon radar?
o: It uses HF waves bounced off the ionosphere to observe targets beyond the horizon.
It uses Doppler shift exclusively to map clouds.
It uses only underwater acoustic signals.
It uses visible laser beams to detect targets beyond mountains.
accepted.x: Over-the-horizon radar uses high-frequency waves reflected by the ionosphere, enabling observation beyond the geometric horizon.
accepted.tq: Match the radar name with the unusual propagation path stated in the options.
accepted.sec: Radar and EW - types, indigenous radars, AEW&C  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which indigenous radar is associated with the long-range tracking function of the ballistic missile defence shield and has a range of more than 1,500 km?
accepted.x: Swordfish is the long-range tracking radar of the ballistic missile defence shield, with a range exceeding 1,500 km.
accepted.tq: Link the named system with its distinctive role and range.
accepted.sec: Radar and EW - types, indigenous radars, AEW&C  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Arudhra radar is primarily associated with which of the following descriptions?
o: IAF medium-range surveillance radar with 360° coverage and a range exceeding 300 km
Akash fire-control radar with an 80-km range
Low-level radar exclusively for detecting drones
accepted.x: Arudhra is an IAF medium-range surveillance radar providing 360° coverage and a range of more than 300 km.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between indigenous radars by comparing role, coverage and range.
accepted.sec: Radar and EW - types, indigenous radars, AEW&C  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: Ashwini — Low-level lightweight 3D radar detecting cruise missiles and drones
Swathi — Fire-control radar of the Akash system
Rajendra — Weapon-locating radar exported to Armenia
Swordfish — Low-level surveillance radar of the IAF
accepted.x: Ashwini is a low-level lightweight 3D radar capable of detecting cruise missiles and drones. Swathi is weapon-locating, Rajendra is associated with Akash, and Swordfish performs long-range tracking.
accepted.tq: Find the correctly matched role by separating surveillance, fire-control and weapon-location functions.
accepted.sec: Radar and EW - types, indigenous radars, AEW&C  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Swathi radar, indigenously made by BEL, is designed primarily to:
o: Track stealth aircraft in the VHF band
Control the air battle from a large aircraft
Locate enemy guns, mortars and rockets
accepted.x: Swathi is a weapon-locating radar that locates enemy guns, mortars and rockets. It has also been exported to Armenia.
accepted.tq: Use the specific targets to identify a weapon-locating radar.
accepted.sec: Radar and EW - types, indigenous radars, AEW&C  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Rajendra radar is associated with which defence system?
accepted.x: Rajendra is the phased-array fire-control radar of the Akash surface-to-air missile system and has an 80-km range.
accepted.tq: Identify the radar from its parent weapon system.
accepted.sec: Radar and EW - types, indigenous radars, AEW&C  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Surya VHF radar is intended mainly for:
o: Detecting submarines below the sea surface
accepted.x: Surya is a VHF-band surveillance radar designed to track stealth aircraft; long wavelengths are useful against stealth targets.
accepted.tq: Use the VHF-band and stealth combination to distinguish Surya from other radars.
accepted.sec: Radar and EW - types, indigenous radars, AEW&C  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about Netra AEW&C is correct?
1. It was built by DRDO-CABS in Bengaluru.
2. It carries an AESA radar on an Embraer EMB-145 aircraft.
3. It can track aircraft, drones, cruise missiles and ships.
4. It provides IFF and can guide friendly fighters.
Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: All four statements correctly describe Netra AEW&C, including its developer, platform, tracking functions, IFF and fighter-guidance role.
accepted.tq: Check each statement against the system’s developer, platform and operational functions.
accepted.sec: Radar and EW - types, indigenous radars, AEW&C  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Netra AEW&C has a stated detection range of approximately:
accepted.x: Netra AEW&C has a detection range of approximately 250–500 km or more, with 300–360° coverage.
accepted.tq: Select the range band associated with the airborne early-warning platform.
accepted.sec: Radar and EW - types, indigenous radars, AEW&C  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Final Operational Clearance for Netra AEW&C was handed over to the Indian Air Force in:
accepted.x: The Final Operational Clearance for Netra AEW&C was handed over to the Indian Air Force in June 2026.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the closely placed year and month-based current-affairs dates.
accepted.sec: Radar and EW - types, indigenous radars, AEW&C  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which statement best distinguishes AWACS from Netra AEW&C?
o: AWACS is a smaller jet with shorter range, whereas Netra is a larger platform for complete air-battle control.
Netra is used only for weather observation, whereas AWACS is used only for naval patrol.
AWACS is a larger platform for long-range surveillance and full control of the air battle, whereas Netra is a smaller jet providing early warning and command-and-control.
Both systems are identical in platform size, range and function.
accepted.x: AWACS is the larger, longer-range platform with full air-battle control, while Netra is a smaller jet offering early warning and command-and-control over a shorter range.
accepted.tq: Compare the two systems across platform size, range and degree of control.
accepted.sec: Radar and EW - types, indigenous radars, AEW&C  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Stealth technology reduces the radar cross-section of a platform primarily through:
o: Increasing the number of mechanically rotating antennas
accepted.x: Radar-absorbing materials and suitable shaping reduce radar reflections and thereby lower radar cross-section. Such features are used on P-17A frigates with flush-mounted weapons.
accepted.tq: Identify the physical measures that reduce radar reflection rather than visual detection.
accepted.sec: Radar and EW - types, indigenous radars, AEW&C  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Arudhra — Medium-Power 4D surveillance radar for the IAF
Ashwini — Low-Level Transportable Radar for the IAF
Surya — Weapon-locating radar for enemy guns and mortars
accepted.x: Surya is a VHF-band surveillance radar for tracking stealth aircraft. Swathi, not Surya, is the weapon-locating radar for enemy guns, mortars and rockets.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped role among closely related indigenous radar systems.
accepted.sec: Radar and EW - types, indigenous radars, AEW&C  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Indrajaal system is best described as:
o: An AI-powered anti-drone grid developed by a Hyderabad start-up
A DRDO ballistic missile tracking radar
accepted.x: Indrajaal is an AI-powered anti-drone grid developed by a Hyderabad start-up. It can cover up to 4,000 sq km and has been deployed at naval sites in Gujarat and Karnataka.
accepted.tq: Identify the system from its developer type and anti-drone function.
accepted.sec: Counter-drone and loitering munitions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: D4, developed by DRDO, combines which of the following capabilities?
o: Only infrared imaging and underwater sonar
accepted.x: D4 means Drone Detect, Deter and Destroy. It uses 360° radar, soft-kill jamming and hard-kill laser; it detects drones at 4 km and neutralises them within 1 km.
accepted.tq: Expand the acronym and connect each component with its soft-kill or hard-kill function.
accepted.sec: Counter-drone and loitering munitions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which indigenous system fires 64 micro-rockets against drone swarms?
accepted.x: Bhargavastra is an indigenous counter-drone system that fires 64 micro-rockets at drone swarms.
accepted.tq: Use the distinctive numerical payload to identify the system.
accepted.sec: Counter-drone and loitering munitions  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Akash Tarang is an indigenous anti-drone electronic-warfare system.
2. It jams drone-control signals as a soft-kill measure.
3. Its procurement was approved by the DAC in July 2026.
4. It forms part of the Sudarshan Chakra layered air shield.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. Akash Tarang is an indigenous anti-UAV EW system using soft-kill jamming, approved for procurement in July 2026 and included in the Sudarshan Chakra layered air shield.
accepted.tq: Combine system identity, method, approval date and wider defence architecture.
accepted.sec: Counter-drone and loitering munitions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Vayu Astra is associated with which of the following?
o: An indigenous loitering munition developed by NIBE Ltd
A VHF radar for stealth aircraft
accepted.x: Vayu Astra is an indigenous loitering munition developed by NIBE Ltd.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a munition from similarly named radar and anti-drone systems.
accepted.sec: Counter-drone and loitering munitions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: A Shahed drone is associated with which country, according to its origin and supply network?
o: Israel, including supply to the DRDO
Armenia, including supply to the IAF
India, including supply to the Coast Guard
Iran, including supply to proxy forces
accepted.x: Shahed is associated with Iran and has also been supplied to proxy forces.
accepted.tq: Use country-of-origin association to distinguish foreign loitering systems.
accepted.sec: Counter-drone and loitering munitions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which statement correctly describes a kamikaze or suicide drone?
o: It is a manned aircraft used for air-sea rescue.
It continuously returns to its base after releasing a non-explosive sensor.
It loiters over an area and crashes into the target carrying a warhead.
It can operate only underwater and has no warhead.
accepted.x: A kamikaze drone loiters over an area and then crashes into its target with a warhead. The DAC approved jet-based kamikaze drones in July 2026.
accepted.tq: Apply the operational definition to a short battlefield scenario.
accepted.sec: Counter-drone and loitering munitions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Electronic warfare is best understood as the use of electromagnetic energy to:
o: Provide civilian internet access through satellites
Increase only the explosive power of missiles
Control the spectrum, deny it to the enemy and protect own sensors
Replace all radar systems with optical cameras
accepted.x: Electronic warfare uses electromagnetic energy to control the spectrum, deny its effective use to the enemy and protect friendly sensors.
accepted.tq: Select the option containing all three elements of the EW definition.
accepted.sec: Counter-drone and loitering munitions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Samyukta — Army mobile integrated ground-based EW system
Himshakti — Anti-drone laser of the Coast Guard
D4 — Mountainous-terrain EW system developed by DLRL Hyderabad
accepted.x: Samyukta is the Army’s mobile integrated ground-based electronic-warfare system. Himshakti is the mountainous-terrain EW system developed by DLRL Hyderabad, while D4 is the DRDO anti-drone system.
accepted.tq: Separate systems by service, terrain and developer before selecting the valid pair.
accepted.sec: Counter-drone and loitering munitions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Himshakti is an integrated electronic-warfare system intended particularly for:
o: Long-range ballistic tracking and developed by BEL
Mountainous terrain and developed by DLRL, Hyderabad
Weather observation and developed by ISRO
Deep-sea operations and developed by the Coast Guard
accepted.x: Himshakti is an integrated EW system for mountainous terrain, developed by DLRL, Hyderabad.
accepted.tq: Link the system with its distinctive terrain and developing laboratory.
accepted.sec: Counter-drone and loitering munitions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Integrated Air Defence Weapon System (IADWS) is characterised by:
o: A multi-layered air-defence configuration including a high-power laser DEW
A naval rescue vessel with an air cushion
A system used exclusively for locating enemy mortars
A single low-level weather radar without any weapon component
accepted.x: IADWS is a multi-layered air-defence system incorporating a high-power laser-directed energy weapon. Its maiden tests were conducted in 2025.
accepted.tq: Identify the system through its layered architecture and directed-energy component.
accepted.sec: Counter-drone and loitering munitions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Indian Coast Guard was set up in:
accepted.x: The Indian Coast Guard was established in 1977.
accepted.tq: Recall the establishment year while avoiding nearby institutional dates.
accepted.sec: Coast Guard - vessel classes and roles  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following represents the current strength of the Indian Coast Guard stated for ships, aircraft, stations, air stations and radar stations, respectively?
o: 78 ships, 152 aircraft, 11 stations, 42 air stations and 84 radar stations
152 ships, 78 aircraft, 42 stations, 11 air stations and 84 radar stations
84 ships, 42 aircraft, 152 stations, 78 air stations and 11 radar stations
152 ships, 84 aircraft, 78 stations, 42 air stations and 11 radar stations
accepted.x: The stated figures are 152 ships, 78 aircraft, 42 stations, 11 air stations and 84 radar stations.
accepted.tq: Read the numerical sequence carefully and avoid exchanging adjacent categories.
accepted.sec: Coast Guard - vessel classes and roles  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Adamya-class Fast Patrol Vessels:
1. Eight vessels are being built by Goa Shipyard.
2. Three were commissioned in 2025.
3. ICGS Achal was commissioned in 2026.
4. Their roles include coastal surveillance, anti-smuggling and search and rescue.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. The Adamya-class vessels are being built by Goa Shipyard and perform surveillance, anti-smuggling and SAR roles.
accepted.tq: Verify the class through builder, commissioning timeline and operational roles.
accepted.sec: Coast Guard - vessel classes and roles  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is the first indigenous air cushion vehicle of the Indian Coast Guard?
accepted.x: Hovercraft H-561 is the first indigenous air cushion vehicle of the Indian Coast Guard, inducted in 2026.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a vessel class from named Coast Guard ships involved in rescue operations.
accepted.sec: Coast Guard - vessel classes and roles  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Coast Guard hovercraft H-561 is particularly suited to operations over:
o: Mudflats and sandbars such as the Rann of Kutch and the Sundarbans
accepted.x: As an air cushion vehicle, H-561 can operate over mudflats and sandbars, including areas such as the Rann of Kutch and the Sundarbans.
accepted.tq: Infer the suitable terrain from the operating characteristics of an air cushion vehicle.
accepted.sec: Coast Guard - vessel classes and roles  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT a stated role of the Indian Coast Guard?
o: Operating intercontinental ballistic missile launch facilities
accepted.x: The Coast Guard performs coastal security, anti-poaching, anti-smuggling and search-and-rescue roles. Operating intercontinental ballistic missile launch facilities is not a stated Coast Guard role.
accepted.tq: Find the unrelated defence function among the Coast Guard’s maritime roles.
accepted.sec: Coast Guard - vessel classes and roles  [APPSC]

accepted.s: ICGS Kanaklata Barua and ICGS Veera were associated with which operation?
o: An air-sea rescue operation off Visakhapatnam
A radar export mission to Armenia
A ballistic missile defence test near Bengaluru
accepted.x: ICGS Kanaklata Barua and ICGS Veera conducted an air-sea rescue operation off Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Identify the event from the vessels and its location.
accepted.sec: Coast Guard - vessel classes and roles  [APPSC]
